text_block_list.text:
Nooo! Someone, please, catch my dear
Maria and
return her to me!
text_block_list.name: Madam

text_block_list.text: Waaah! The dog is coming this way!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: All... right, I'm g-going to catch—
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Eek?! Now the leash is caught around my
leg!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
The dog drags Мэйсё Дото around until
evening,
leaving her completely
exhausted.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
